rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality expanded/early hatching blastocyst with generally appropriate caveats, but introduces uncertainty and possible discrepancies (4 vs 5 stage, ICM less crisp than AA) and mentions features not firmly supportable from a single image.

Integrates key factors well, especially maternal age-related aneuploidy risk, endometrial thickness, BMI, ovarian reserve, first cycle status, and mild male-factor considerations, though some interactions could be more tightly linked to prognosis.

Overall logic is reasonable, but there are internal inconsistencies in probability framing and terminology (implantation vs clinical pregnancy/live birth), plus some wavering on morphology and grading interpretation.

Generally consistent with IVF practice: recognizes Gardner staging nuance, supports single embryo transfer, avoids bed rest, and appropriately frames PGT-A as discussable rather than mandatory; minor deviations include some speculative comments and imprecise rate statements.

Provides practical recommendations for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, prenatal optimization, and consideration of PGT-A or sperm DNA fragmentation if needed, though some advice remains somewhat generic.
